matrix_name.name: epoxy
matrix_name.description: Epoxy matrix cured with an unspecified hardener; epoxy/hardener ratio reported as 4:1 in acetone during preparation.

fillers.name: graphene
fillers.description: Solution-processable functionalized graphene (SPFG) / graphene-based sheets; exfoliated from graphite oxide, partially reduced with hydrazine hydrate, then fully reduced by annealing at 250 °C for 2 h under N2. Reported loading is 15 wt%, equivalent to 8.8 vol.%.
